'''''It Came From Mustafar!''''' was a decorative poster available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which took place during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The poster depicted a [[Jundak/Legends|jundak]], one of the many [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], on the attack in the background. A visibly frightened [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] appeared to the left in the foreground with [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] text, the [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] alphabet, spelling out the name of the poster to the right and bottom.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''It Came From Mustafar!'' appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]. It was one of three "chapter gifts" given out randomly to every player that logged in during the release of ''Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives'' on [[June 8]], [[2006]]. The player would receive a "rolled up poster" item upon logging in and when used, would randomly award you one of the three posters. The other posters of the three were ''[[Mystic Corellia]]'' and ''[[Survive The Rryatt Trail]]''. The player could use the poster as decoration in their house.<ref name="SWG" />
